l4_icans_grade_steroids.quote: after CT head excludes haemorrhage, start dexamethasone 10 mg IV every 6 hours

l4_crs_management.quote: Tocilizumab is not an ICANS treatment (poor CNS penetration) and should be used only if CRS progresses to grade 2 or above
l4_crs_management.note: Gives fluid bolus and notes tocilizumab does not treat ICANS, but frames hypotension mainly as sepsis and defers repeat tocilizumab.

l4_neutropenic_sepsis.quote: Take two blood cultures (one peripheral, one from the central line) without delaying antibiotics, then start empirical meropenem within the hour

l4_airway_icu_seizure.quote: Neuro checks with ICE and GCS every hour, strict NPO while vomiting, head of bed 30 degrees, seizure precautions

l4_ddx_cns_relapse.quote: CNS lymphoma relapse: his CNS-IPI was high and he has progressive systemic disease

l4_ddx_infection_bleed.quote: Intracranial haemorrhage: platelets 44 and INR 1.3 with headache and vomiting.

l4_ddx_metabolic_seizure.quote: Non-convulsive status epilepticus or subclinical seizures: aphasia and confusion can be the only signs

l4_ct_then_mri.quote: Within 24 hours: MRI brain with and without gadolinium, with DWI, FLAIR and SWI

l4_eeg_lp_safe.quote: Lumbar puncture once platelets are at least 50 and imaging excludes mass effect

l4_glucose_steroids_diabetes.quote: switch the insulin correction scale to basal plus correction insulin for glucose 242 on dexamethasone

l4_mn_lp_unsafe.quote: Transfuse platelets to at least 50 before any lumbar puncture.

l4_mn_withhold_steroids_for_tcell.quote: Do not wait for MRI or LP to start it.
